title: Anna & Markus
description: Anna and Markus, recently engaged, are trekking in the Alps. On the morning of the 3rd day, Anna wakes up alone in the tent. Markus has disappeared, leaving all his belongings and his phone.

questions.question: My phone is broken and I need to make sure Markus didn't have an accident. The game wardens must have sent an alert about the region if there was an incident... What canton are we in exactly?
questions.hint: Open the app that allows you to locate the phone's current position

questions.question: What's the latest news from the local game wardens? I'm too scared to look but I need to know...
questions.hint: Open Safari, search carefully for local info to give two keywords

questions.question: Thank God... I can't find his Apple Watch anymore. He must have left with it. Check his pulse please.
questions.hint: Open the health app to find Markus's current BPM (heartbeats per minute)

questions.question: At least he's alive, I'm relieved. Had he planned to go away from our campsite last night? If so, find where he went. Maybe he got lost
questions.hint: Open the calendar and look between yesterday and today for what Markus had planned. Open ChatGPT to compile the calendar info

questions.question: That's the stopover village we passed through yesterday at noon! Why did he go back there? It doesn't make sense.
questions.hint: Open the notes to find what Markus needs to do in Marguns

questions.question: Talk to Nora... why he needed to see her... Who is this Nora?
questions.hint: Open a conversation with Nora to find her position

questions.question: That's the cable car that goes back to the start of the hiking trail! How many tickets did he buy for the cable car?
questions.hint: Open Safari to find the price of a cable car ticket. Open Wallet to see how much he spent in Marguns and calculate the number of tickets he bought.

questions.question: But what did he have so important planned today to leave me here...?
questions.hint: Open the Calendar on today's date for new information. Open Wallet to find a transaction corresponding to the same date.

questions.question: How is he taking a plane? What time is his flight?
questions.hint: Unlock the hidden photo gallery to find info about the plane ticket. The code is hidden in Markus's Notes

questions.question: I'd never make it in time, he clearly didn't plan to leave with me. I don't understand what's happening... Since when has he planned to abandon me on this mountain?
questions.hint: Open a discussion with his brother (Bhai) to discover since when Markus planned to leave

questions.question: I should be furious but I can't believe it. It's too brutal for me... Why did he do this?
answer: Things to settle in the country
Things to settle first in the country
Things to settle in the country
Things to settle first in the country
questions.hint: Open a conversation with his father (Baba) to find the reason for Markus's departure

questions.question: I thought his parents wouldn't come to our engagement party for a reason I can't remember anymore, but actually it's Markus who lied. What was the bogus excuse he gave me?
questions.hint: Open ChatGPT to find what excuse Markus made up for Anna

questions.question: A coward… Who else knew about what Markus was planning to do to me?
questions.hint: Open a conversation with one of his friends, who knows about the situation, to give his first name to Anna

questions.question: He intended to play dead rather than break off our engagement, it's disgusting. Where is he going to land?
questions.hint: Open the received emails to find Markus's flight destination. Turkish Airlines tells you the country — what is its largest city?

questions.question: Why is Markus suddenly returning to Turkey? Can you find out what awaits him there?
questions.hint: Search Instagram to find a person who has recently become important to Markus

questions.question: This Ayline… Who is she exactly? I need her full identity.
questions.hint: Ayline's public profile might be hiding another more personal account

questions.question: Wait… Why would he leave everything for this girl? He was ready to let me believe he was dead just to leave and find this girl? What's so important about her to him?
answer: His parents want him to marry a Turkish woman
His parents want him to marry a Turkish woman
Parents want him to marry a Turkish woman
Parents want him to marry a Turkish woman
questions.hint: Translate the old messages between Markus and Ayline to understand why Markus really wants to leave

textSuccess: I can't believe it... He preferred to let me think he was dead rather than tell me the truth. Two years of lying to me, two years of building his life with someone else. All of that just to obey his parents... I'm coming down from this mountain and going home. Thank you for helping me discover who he really is.

onboardingContent.text: Hi... My name is Anna. I don't know you but I really need help. It's an emergency and I don't know who else to turn to.
My fiancé Markus and I have been trekking in the Swiss Alps for 3 days. This morning I woke up... and he had disappeared. Completely vanished.
He left all his stuff in the tent, even his phone. Markus never goes anywhere without his phone, never! Something is very wrong.
I have his phone with me. Can you help me search through it? There might be clues about what happened to him. Please, I'm begging you...

messages.text: Hello Sir, here is the information you requested regarding your reservation request.
Hello, thank you very much. May I confirm a few details with you?
You are indeed the ticket clerk at the cable car station?
Yes exactly, I've been working at this station for 2 years.
Perfect, thank you for this confirmation. This helps me with the file.
Which company do you work for exactly?
I work at Fiduciaire Weber & Associés in Zurich.
Very good, I've noted that. How long have you been in this profession?
I've been a qualified accountant for 3 years now.
Perfect. And you do live in Zurich?
Yes, exactly. I live in the Oerlikon district.
Excellent. Do you have valid ID that you can present?
Yes, I have my Swiss passport and my ID card.
Perfect. One last question: what is your work phone number?
Thank you very much. I have all the necessary information.
May I ask in what context you needed this information?
It's to finalize your reservation file, standard procedure.
I understand. Is there anything else you need to verify?
No, it's perfect. Your request will be processed as soon as possible.
Excellent. What timeframe can I expect for confirmation?
You should receive confirmation within 48 hours maximum.
Perfect, thank you very much for your professionalism.
Have a good day Monsieur Ange.
Have a good day as well, see you soon.
it's okay... what are you doing tonight?

you know... that plan I told you about

I have a package for you, the delivery guy couldn't find your apartment

messages.content:
Hey Markus! Of course, here are some quick tips for personal budgeting:
- Set a monthly budget and track expenses.
